description: This file defines classes for integrating Google Generative AI models with Langchain, including a main class for chat models, configuration options, and support for structured output, multimodal inputs, and tool binding.

classes.name: LangchainChatGoogleGenerativeAI
classes.description: Main class for Google Generative AI chat models, supporting configuration, streaming, structured output, and tool binding.

classes.name: ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
classes.description: Extended class supporting multimodal inputs and model configuration, inheriting from LangchainChatGoogleGenerativeAI.

methods.name: withStructuredOutput
methods.description: Configures the model to produce structured output based on a schema, supporting JSON schema and function calling methods.

methods.name: bindTools
methods.description: Binds external tools to the model for use during interactions.

methods.name: completionWithRetry
methods.description: Executes a content generation request with retry logic.

methods.name: _generate
methods.description: Generates a response from messages, handling streaming and token usage.

methods.name: _streamResponseChunks
methods.description: Streams response chunks from the model, yielding partial responses.
